data.one_liner: Decode EXIF metadata from various image formats in Dart, Web, and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: exif_reader parses EXIF data from TIFF, JPEG, HEIC, AVIF, PNG, WebP, JXL, ARW, RAW, DNG, CRW, CR3, NRW, NEF, RAF files. It returns an ExifData object containing tags and warnings.
use_when: You need to read EXIF tags from image files in a Dart or Flutter app.
You want a pure Dart solution that works on mobile, web, and desktop without native plugins.
You need support for newer formats like JXL or CR3 via RandomAccessSource.
avoid_when: You only need a subset of EXIF tags and prefer a lighter dependency footprint.
You are building a library that must avoid external dependencies like random_access_source.
strengths: Pure Dart implementation with WebAssembly support for performance.
Supports a wide range of image formats including newer ones (JXL, CR3).
No native platform code required; works on all supported platforms.
weaknesses: Requires random_access_source for file access, adding an extra dependency.
Some formats (CR3, JXL) still need dart:io when loaded from files, limiting full web support.
No built‑in UI helpers; purely a data extraction library.
data.setup_notes: Add exif_reader and random_access_source to pubspec. No special permissions needed.
